reviews.text:
The veterinary care in Benfica is great, I loved it, very attentive and professional.
However, the experience in the store was terrible. I went into the Benfica store, said good afternoon to 3 employees and none of them even looked at me. I was completely ignored and ended up leaving without buying anything. First time I went there.

I recommend Kiwoko at UBBO, they are super friendly and attentive there. I hope they improve the service at the Benfica store, because the veterinary part deserves 5 stars.

Excellent professionals 👏👏👏👏👏
Thank you so much to the whole team!
They took care of my THUNDER 🐕‍🦺💙
Today they are taking care of my MEL 🐕‍🦺🩷
Always with great dedication, professionalism, affection, love...
Highly recommended ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Neither the pet shop nor the clinic has the prices displayed as required by general law, specifically Decree-Law No. 138/90 of April 26, as currently amended.

The next time I see that they still don't have the prices displayed, especially at the pet shop, I will have to report it to the competent authorities.
Five-star professionals. Dr. Nelson Santos is the one who takes care of our family of pets, and we have 100% confidence in him because of his constant professionalism and dedication.

Super dedicated and attentive professionals with our furry friends.
I recommend them 🙂 …

They just want to line their pockets at the expense of animal suffering. 0 helpfulness, 0 sympathy. I don't recommend them. I made the mistake of having a cat die once, and only after it was dead were they able to determine the cause, and now with the death of a dog... well, that's it.

Terrible telephone service, dirty rooms, they should have veterinarians with more experience! Instead of giving the wrong diagnosis for the second time!! I do not recommend it, my dog ​​is no longer being followed there, now he is in excellent hands with capable professionals.
Zero empathy for customers. Everything is ridiculously expensive!!!

Our 12-year-old Lua underwent surgery, and during the post-operative period (due to scheduling issues on our part) we were seen by almost all the veterinarians at the clinic 😅 Our gratitude to all the staff, doctors, and assistants for all the care, dedication, commitment, and professionalism with which they treated our girl 😊 Thank you very much ❤️

I had a wonderful experience at this clinic. My cat was hospitalized at the Arroios clinic, but I needed to take her to the Benfica clinic for an examination. I'm sharing my experience from both Arroios and Benfica here. Everyone who attended to me was kind and attentive. The doctor who saw my cat, who was very sick, was extremely helpful and quick in what needed to be done, giving me all the explanations and alternatives available to me. The other doctors who treated my cat were equally attentive, empathetic, and extremely helpful. After hospitalization and medication, my cat returned home a few days later completely different from the worrying state she was in when we arrived at the clinic. I am very happy with all the attention, care, and affection they gave my Morganinha.

Worst veterinarian I've ever been to. Only interested in money, they charge separately for services that are included in the procedure price at other veterinarians. After spending almost €400, my cat only got worse. Obviously, I refused other proposed treatments (which were expensive and risky given her age and health) and took her to another veterinarian, where she started to improve without needing those procedures. I tried to request an ultrasound report, which I was told would cost €10, but to my surprise, since I didn't request it that same day, the price doubled. When I asked for the price list with this information, they simply stopped responding. After I officially complained, they said they had offered me the report free of charge, information that was never given to me. I wouldn't recommend them to anyone.

The hours listed on Google are incorrect; this clinic closes at 8 PM, not 10 PM as stated on Google.

They take days to answer the phone.

Our Thunder (dog) was lucky to find great professionals, but above all, to find great human beings. On June 14, 2024, our Thunder left us. It was an enormous pain, but we were lucky to be with those same human beings, who supported us …
